verdictBasis: The stated gate is 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, and I find 0 of each. The two findings that made v7 a REJECT are genuinely repaired in v8's bytes, by the minimum repair Codex specified and to the invariant Claude charged: /reviewGuidance/forTheIndependentReviewer now carries exactly one current HEAD instruction, updated in place at item 7 to e0232a6 (D-128 ADOPTED), the contradictory 5827371 present-tense line is gone, and the only surviving mentions of 5827371 are past-tense repair accounting outside the reviewer-directing array. The repair was made without collateral movement: a full leaf-path diff shows 37 changed paths and every one falls inside the closed roster declared at /basedOn/method, so no decided clause, fixture class, identity dependency, pin, or disclaimer shifted under cover of the repair. The substance re-measures true independently. The D-032 carry is byte-exact across all 34 lines and its section digest is reproducible only under the honest framing. The file 08 row is byte-exact, uniquely locatable by ID, and OPEN. All 29 recorded-input pins and all seven named-candidate digests reproduce. Every recordedAt claim matches the live COORD entry. The three claims most exposed to over-reach all hold in the direction that costs the artifact authority rather than grants it: the later D-000 CA-2 gate and CA-1 IN_PROCESS unexercisability are attributed to recorded host-effect v8/v25 and are demonstrably absent from D-032, and the PT-* token vocabulary is grounded in the recorded DR-105 tables rather than invented. The five-member host-side roster is fully dispositioned. The v9 leftover-integration is real rather than asserted, since v9's own frozen bytes carry the CA-1/CA-2 resolution and D-128 records it with exactly the standing v8 claims, while v8 applies nothing. One advisory carries forward unrepaired, CLAUDE-DAJ7-A1, and I decline to escalate it: the register records it as ADVISORY-NON-BLOCKING rather than claiming a repair it did not make, only a location pointer has drifted, no repair is misattributed, /honestyRepairsStanding is GOVERNING and already covers historical accounting, and the optional fix would require opening a path the closed roster does not declare. That is materially unlike CLAUDE-DAJ5-A1, which was charged because a disposition credited a repair to an act that had not performed it. Nothing here is charged on the PASS-NO-SCOPE-EFFECT allowance, because the subject, file 08, COORD, and the D-032 section all reproduced their dispatched pins at both start and end of this review.
